subject: AP routing and onboarding: next steps for LumosHealth
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Li <sasha.li@lumoshealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: AP routing and onboarding: next steps for LumosHealth

Hi Sasha —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick written recap and a few asks so we can keep momentum on procurement readiness:

Summary of call:
- Primary goals: run a 90-day pilot of Redwood Dedicated for the clinical NLP ingest pipeline, then expand to production when throughput needs scale.
- Procurement preferences you mentioned: pilot ideally on card, long-term purchases via PO for >$10k, AP prefers vendor portal for onboarding.
- Compliance needs: W9, standard SOC 2 redline review (you flagged a short internal review window).

Open items / asks from LumosHealth:
1) Who owns vendor onboarding in AP (name + email) so we can send the vendor packet and W9?
2) Confirm thresholds: you said pilots under $5k typically go on corporate card — can you confirm the upper pilot limit?
3) Marketplace interest: you noted your platform team is considering vendor marketplace procurement for later — any timeline?

Attachments: Lumos_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet) — quick internal checklist for Lumos to attach required docs.

Proposed next steps:
- Jordan to send standard W9 + vendor packet link (attached).
- Internal: align on pilot pricing and confirm whether we can accept PO terms for initial 6 months if they sign a master services agreement.
- Target: get PO decision or card approval within two weeks to lock pilot start date.

If it helps, we can offer a short 90-day pilot invoice structure: initial month billed to card (to remove friction) + 60-day PO for expansion. Happy to map this out in the MAP and send over a DocuSign once AP confirms process.

Thanks — looping in Karthik and Marissa to confirm commercial options and next steps.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

On Thu, Jul 22, 2027 at 2:05 PM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sasha —
> 
> Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick written recap and a few asks so we can keep momentum on procurement readiness:

Hi Jordan — thanks for the recap and the checklist. Quick answers below to keep this moving: 

1) AP owner: Ben Turner (ben.turner@lumoshealth.com). He manages vendor setup and the portal. Please send the vendor packet directly to him.
2) Thresholds: correct — pilots <$5k we route on card. Anything between $5k-$15k we typically prefer a short-term PO; >$15k requires a formal PO with our procurement SLA (internal approvals). For a 90-day pilot your suggested structure (month 1 card + remainder on PO) should be fine as long as Ben signs off.
3) Marketplace: we don't use a centralized marketplace today; our vendor ops team is evaluating AWS Marketplace for Q4 but no firm timeline.

Compliance / docs: attaching our W9. We will need Redwood to accept our PO template for production purchases (we can share the template, and it usually has 30-60 day net terms).

Timeline: Ben can review vendor setup within 3 business days once he has the packet. Procurement legal typically needs 5-7 business days to review a standard MSA redline.

Attachment: Lumos_W9.pdf (PDF)

Happy to jump on a quick call with Ben if that helps speed vendor onboarding.

Regards,
Sasha Li
Procurement Manager | LumosHealth
sasha.li@lumoshealth.com | +1 (617) 555-4421
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: AP routing and onboarding: next steps for LumosHealth

Great — appreciate the fast turnaround, Sasha. Notes and internal asks (copying Karthik / Marissa):

What we heard from Lumos:
- Pilot flexibility: card for <$5k; PO acceptable for mid-size pilots ($5k-$15k); formal PO and MSA for production (> $15k).
- Vendor portal preferred for onboarding; AP owner is Ben Turner.
- Procurement legal review 5-7 business days once they receive our redlines.

Proposed commercial path (recommended):
1) Offer a 90-day pilot: month 1 on Lumos card (minimizes friction), month 2-3 invoiced via a short-term PO if Ben approves.
2) If pilot converts, execute MSA and transition to PO-based purchasing for production with net-45 payment terms (subject to negotiation).

Internal asks for Karthik / Marissa:
- Confirm we can accept Lumos' PO template or propose our standard PO acceptance language; any legal redlines we need to anticipate?
- Can Finance support a card-to-PO transition for pilot billing (i.e., initial card invoice then convert remaining pilot billing to PO)?
- Pricing: propose we keep pilot pricing at the agreed demo rate with a one-time setup credit to offset onboarding. Marissa, please confirm numbers and whether a one-time credit fits cadence.

External next steps (to Sasha / Ben):
- Jordan to send vendor packet + Redwood W9 (attached in the vendor packet) to Ben Turner.
- Lumos to share PO template and Ben to confirm expected turnaround.
- Schedule a 20-minute onboarding sync with Ben (Jordan + Karthik + Marissa) — propose Tue 27 Jul 10:00 AM PT / Tue 27 Jul 1:00 PM ET.

Attachment: MAP_LumosHealth.pdf (proposal / mutual action plan)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/7834
DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abc123-lumos-contract

If Karthik / Marissa can confirm internal acceptance of the PO transition and pricing by EOD Monday, I will loop in Ben and book the onboarding sync.
